authorization_source: explicit user authorization in the current request; EVOVARIANT_TR_OVERNIGHT_MASTER_CARD.md is the current autonomous execution and compute authorization

budget_control.billing_basis: read-only Modal workspace metered-cost delta plus runner wall-time rate estimates; no per-run invoice claim

dataset.locked_labels_boundary: labels remain inaccessible until the post-freeze one-shot Phase 14 evaluation

git.working_tree_policy: approval is bound to tracked HEAD; unrelated pre-existing untracked files are preserved and do not enter remote payloads

gpu.region_policy: use the configured Modal H100 region; record provider runtime evidence

allowed_workloads: formal Phase 6 Evo2 scoring over the frozen 4,000-row TRAIN/VALIDATION development cohort
Phase 7 representation extraction for the predeclared Nucleotide Transformer layers 8/16/24 and Caduceus layers 4/8/16
Phase 14 one-shot LOCKED_TEST scoring only after model, feature family, ensemble, calibration, and threshold selection freeze
CPU-local Phase 8, Phase 9, Phase 11, Phase 12, Phase 13, Phase 15, Phase 16, Phase 17, Phase 18, and Phase 19 verification and report work
excluded_workloads: full T0 rescoring or T0/T1 reprocessing
full Evo2 fine-tuning unless a separately evidenced cheap path is explicitly approved; default status remains DEFERRED_BY_COMPUTE
clinical use, clinical claims, or clinical deployment
automatic deployment, public release, GitHub push, or credential use
any locked-test label access, model selection, threshold selection, or tuning before the documented freeze
stop_conditions: stop before cumulative additional metered cost reaches the $13.50 safety stop and absolutely before the $14.00 hard cap
preserve at least $2.50 of unused authorization for the one-shot Phase 14 locked test
stop immediately if no labels may be sent to a remote worker or if any active container remains unexpectedly after a workload
stop on non-finite results, reference mismatch, duplicate or unexpected IDs, stale hashes, failed resume integrity, or any unapproved workload
do not claim a completed phase when no artifact and independent validation evidence exist

execution_contract.fine_tuning: deferred unless separately justified by remaining budget and an explicit new approval
execution_contract.release_boundary: local artifacts and commits only; no push, deployment, or public release

cost_baseline.baseline_scope: read-only snapshot captured before any paid workload in this authorization
